summary: Implemented Graph.cbd(resource) in rdflib/graph.py (placed after de_skolemize, before ConjunctiveGraph) with a nested add_to_cbd helper implementing the W3C CBD rules 1–3 as specified, and added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase covering rule 1/2 counts, typed and untyped reifiers (cases A=8, B=13), incoming reification, blank nodes inside reifiers, blank-node cycles, and source immutability. Nothing was run, per instructions; counts were verified by hand only. No commit was made.
